title: Cloud Puppy & Friends
subtitle: Infiltrate Dr. Magnor's Volcano Lair
description: Dress in cosplay, sneak lunches into a comic book convention, get kidnapped by the evil Magnor, sabotage the control panel, and escape the exploding volcano.

characters.name: Cloud Puppy
characters.description: Both a cloud and a puppy, CLOUD PUPPY is an anxious but excitable little scamp who is excited to learn what her friends are into!

characters.name: Berry Rose
characters.description: A great friend and a chill hang, BERRY ROSE is a teddy bear but also a unicorn but also a fairy.

characters.name: Mossquatch
characters.description: Even though he's super big he's also quite gentle and nice. He has no neck — his head just sits right in the middle of his shoulders.

characters.name: Jack
characters.description: Pretty much just a deer, but as the oldest and bravest of the gang he ends up getting everyone to do what he wants.

challenges.prompt: It's time for your second ever comic book convention! The first one was nearly ruined by costuming conflicts, but not this one! WHAT COSTUME WILL YOU WEAR THIS TIME?
You're short on cash, so you and your friends decide to sneak your lunches in rather than paying convention prices. WHAT WILL YOU PACK FOR YOUR SECRET LUNCH?
challenges.goal: Pack a lunch you can sneak into a convention.

challenges.prompt: Lunch hidden, you enter the main hall with the guards none the wiser! It's 40 minutes until the first panel. WHAT DO YOU DO TO PASS THE TIME?
challenges.goal: Pick something enjoyable you can do at a comics convention.

challenges.prompt: You spy someone in an absolutely perfect Magnor costume! He's the villain of your favorite series. HOW DO YOU GET HIS ATTENTION?
Oh no! It actually IS Magnor! He picks you up and carries you to his LavaMobile. You can't see where he's driving. HOW DO YOU FIGURE OUT WHERE YOU'RE GOING?
challenges.goal: Come up with a reasonable way to guess where you are going.

challenges.prompt: You're in Magnor's volcano lair! The guards are leading you to a prison cell. HOW DO YOU ESCAPE THE GUARDS?
You've escaped the guards but need to hide while you figure out a plan. WHERE DO YOU HIDE IN THE SECRET VOLCANO LAIR?
You decide to stop Magnor yourself! But you'll need a disguise first. HOW DO YOU GET A DISGUISE SO YOU LOOK LIKE A VOLCANO WORKER?
You're hungry and duck into the break room to eat your hidden lunch. Some volcano workers come in! WHAT DO YOU SAY TO THEM AS SMALL TALK?
challenges.goal: Bring up a topic of general interest.

challenges.prompt: You reach the control room. Magnor is about to release lava to burn the convention! In front of you is a control panel covered with bright, beautiful buttons. WHAT BUTTONS DO YOU PRESS?
You've done it! But you've got to escape now, and fast. You spy a bicycle, a helicopter, and an open window. HOW DO YOU ESCAPE?
You're out of the volcano but need to get back to the convention. You're in an unfamiliar area. HOW DO YOU FIGURE OUT YOUR WAY BACK?
You get back and see your friends. They notice you've changed into a Magnor volcano worker uniform. HOW DO YOU EXPLAIN YOUR ABSENCE AND NEW OUTFIT?
challenges.goal: Explain your absence and new costume.

challenges.prompt: You missed nearly all of the convention, but there's still an hour or two left. HOW DO YOU MAKE THE MOST OF YOUR REMAINING TIME?
challenges.goal: Pick something enjoyable you can do at a comics convention.
